english.title: Drive a motor vehicle on a special road / motorway and exceed 60 mph speed limit - manned equipment
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) drove a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), on a special road, namely **(..SPECIFY SPECIAL ROAD / MOTORWAY AND LOCATION..), at a speed exceeding 60 miles per hour imposed by regulations, namely **(..SPECIFY THE REGULATIONS FOR THE RELEVANT SECTION OF SPECIAL ROAD / MOTORWAY..)
english.legislation: Contrary to the above regulations and section 17(2), (3) and (4) of the Road Traffic Regulation Act 1984 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
